output.review_comment: The validation (slot must divide 1440) and midnight-wrap fixes are correct and match the docstring. The switch to banker's rounding (`round()`) is not. The documented spec says halfway times round up to the later boundary. The PR admits the change was made only so `test_morning_standup_half_hour_slot` (09:15, 30 → 09:00) passes, and it rewrites the docstring to match. Round-half-to-even on the slot index isn't a sensible booking rule: halfway times go up or down depending only on whether the slot index is even (08:45 goes up, 09:15 goes down). That test contradicts both the agreed spec and `test_halfway_rounds_up`. The right move is to keep round-half-up, keep the other two fixes, and ask the teammate or workplace team about the conflicting test instead of quietly redefining the spec.
